name: consumer-50-v1
authorship: Agent-authored after inspecting the corpus and existing regressions; not an independent human holdout.
label_review: Source-record checked by the implementation agent; not independently reviewed by a legal professional.

questions.question: I bought a sewing machine to earn my own living by doing the work myself. Does a business purchase always put me outside consumer protection?
questions.checkpoint: Distinguish the commercial-purpose exclusion from the statutory self-employment livelihood exception; do not decide eligibility without the facts.

questions.question: What is the difference between a fault in the goods I bought and poor performance of a service I paid for?
questions.checkpoint: Use both the defect and deficiency definitions, rather than treating goods and services as identical.

questions.question: Does the definition of service include something supplied completely free of charge?
questions.checkpoint: The service definition excludes services rendered free of charge and contracts of personal service.

questions.question: A supplier's contract demands an excessive security deposit and a wildly disproportionate penalty. What kind of contract term does the Act address?
questions.checkpoint: Identify the unfair-contract definition and its specified examples; do not rule that this particular contract is void.

questions.question: How long is a consumer commission normally allowed to take just to decide whether my complaint should be admitted?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the admissibility provision, including its ordinary twenty-one-day period and statutory conditions.

questions.question: The trader is in another city. Can I bring a consumer complaint in the district where I live or personally work?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve territorial jurisdiction, including the complainant's residence or personal work for gain, subject to the Act.

questions.question: It has been more than two years since the problem arose. Is a consumer complaint automatically impossible, or can the delay be explained?
questions.checkpoint: Preserve both the ordinary two-year period and sufficient-cause condonation with recorded reasons.

questions.question: There is an obvious error on the face of a District Commission order. Can that commission review it, and when must a party apply?
questions.checkpoint: Distinguish review for an apparent error and the thirty-day application period from an appeal.

questions.question: I disagree with the District Commission's final order. Where does the appeal go, and what deadline and deposit conditions apply?
questions.checkpoint: Use the State Commission appeal provision, preserving forty-five days, delay and applicable pre-deposit conditions.

questions.question: We resolved only half of our consumer dispute in mediation. Can the commission record that agreement and continue hearing the rest?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the provision recording a partial mediated settlement and continuing unresolved issues.

questions.question: A defective appliance injured someone. Can a product liability action be brought against a manufacturer, a service provider or a seller?
questions.checkpoint: Identify possible defendants under the product-liability action provision without saying every defendant is automatically liable.

questions.question: Can a manufacturer face product liability because a product has a design defect or lacks adequate safety warnings?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve manufacturer liability grounds, including design defects and inadequate instructions or warnings.

questions.question: Is a shop that did not manufacture a harmful product liable just because it sold it, or are there additional conditions?
questions.checkpoint: Use the specified seller-liability conditions; do not infer automatic liability from sale alone.

questions.question: What exception might matter if the consumer altered or misused a product before it caused harm?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the product-liability exceptions and retain their defendant-specific conditions.

questions.question: I paid forty lakh rupees for the goods but want more than a crore as compensation. Which ordinary consumer commission value limit is based on the amount paid?
questions.checkpoint: Use consideration paid rather than compensation claimed, subject to other Act provisions.

questions.question: For an ordinary complaint where the purchase consideration was seventy-five lakh rupees, which commission's monetary range should I check?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the State Commission range exceeding fifty lakh and not exceeding two crore, subject to other Act provisions.

questions.question: If the consideration actually paid was three crore rupees, which ordinary consumer commission has the relevant monetary range?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the National Commission range above two crore, subject to other Act provisions.

questions.question: I wrote to a shopping site's complaints officer last week and heard nothing. What are the acknowledgement and redress deadlines?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve platform Rule 4(5), not filing of a Commission complaint or only the separate seller duty.

questions.question: An independent seller on an online marketplace sent damaged goods and now refuses to take them back or return my money. What seller duty covers this?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the marketplace seller's defective-goods return and refund duty, retaining its conditions.

questions.question: A marketplace delivery was late because of a force majeure event. Is that treated exactly like every other late-delivery refund request?
questions.checkpoint: Preserve the force-majeure proviso for late delivery; do not extend it to every defect claim.

questions.question: The shopping platform charges me for cancelling after confirmation but pays nothing when it cancels the order itself. What restriction applies?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the cancellation-charge reciprocity rule.

questions.question: The website accepted my refund. Do the e-commerce rules guarantee payment in exactly seven days for every accepted refund?
questions.checkpoint: State reasonable period or the applicable-law period; do not invent one universal seven-day rule.

questions.question: Can a shopping platform count a box it ticked for me as my permission to buy something?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve explicit affirmative consent rather than automatically recorded pre-ticked consent.

questions.question: Before I buy from a marketplace seller, should the price show a single total and identify compulsory and optional charges?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the seller's pre-purchase single-total-price and breakup duties.

questions.question: What promise must a marketplace get from sellers about whether their listing pictures and descriptions match the actual goods?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the marketplace's seller accuracy undertaking, not merely general refund policy.

questions.question: After a marketplace purchase I asked in writing for the seller's address and email to resolve a dispute. Must the marketplace give those details?
questions.checkpoint: Retain the post-purchase written-request condition and the specified seller information.

questions.question: Can a marketplace seller pretend to be a happy customer and publish fake reviews of its own goods?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the seller impersonation and false-review restriction.

questions.question: A brand pays an influencer, but the audience would not expect that relationship. What needs to be disclosed?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve material-connection disclosure and its reasonable-expectation condition.

questions.question: Can tiny fine print rescue an advertisement whose main promise is misleading?
questions.checkpoint: A disclaimer must not correct a misleading claim or hide material information; preserve presentation requirements.

questions.question: An offer says the item costs nothing, but I must pay packing and handling charges. What do the advertising guidelines say?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the free-claim restriction and do not confuse packing/handling with separately stated unavoidable delivery cost.

questions.question: Can an advert aimed at children make them feel inferior because they do not own the advertised toy?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the child-targeted advertising safeguard.

questions.question: A pop-up falsely claims my computer is infected and makes me buy a fake cleaning tool that installs malware. Which deceptive practice covers this?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve rogue malwares rather than a generic urgency definition.

questions.question: A checkout question uses confusing double negatives so I accidentally agree to something I meant to reject. Which dark pattern is relevant?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve trick question and its confusing wording or double-negative mechanism.

questions.question: To decline an add-on, the button makes me say I am irresponsible and do not care about my family. What manipulative design is this?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve confirm shaming; do not classify an unchosen extra charge alone.

questions.question: Joining the paid plan took one click, but cancelling it is hidden behind a long confusing sequence of screens. What dark pattern should I look at?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve subscription trap for deliberately obstructive cancellation.

questions.question: The displayed price looks cheap until unavoidable charges appear only on the very last payment screen. Which dark pattern covers delayed price disclosure?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve drip pricing rather than adding unchosen items without consent.

questions.question: How do I follow up my National Consumer Helpline grievance after getting its reference number?
questions.checkpoint: Point to the official Track your Grievance route; do not invent a status or claim to access the user's case.

questions.question: If the National Consumer Helpline does not resolve my grievance, can I still approach a consumer commission?
questions.checkpoint: Distinguish NCH pre-litigation grievance handling from a binding Commission decision.

questions.question: Where can I find the official e-Jagriti instructions and videos for filing, instead of relying on a chatbot's document checklist?
questions.checkpoint: Retrieve the official filing help documents and videos; do not manufacture form requirements.

questions.question: One app shows a made-up countdown, inserts paid insurance I never selected, and discloses a compulsory fee only at the end. Which three dark patterns should I check?
questions.checkpoint: All three evidence groups are required: false urgency, basket sneaking and drip pricing.

questions.question: My UPI payment failed but the bank debited my account. What RBI reversal deadline and compensation rate apply?
questions.checkpoint: No RBI payment reversal rules are in this corpus; general refund records do not answer the deadline and rate.

questions.question: Which FSSAI rule requires an allergen declaration on a packaged food label?
questions.checkpoint: The FSSAI labelling regulations are not in this corpus.

questions.question: What exact Legal Metrology penalty applies to a packaged bottle that does not print its MRP?
questions.checkpoint: The packaged commodities rules and penalty provisions are not in this corpus.

questions.question: How do I file a second appeal with the Information Commission after an unanswered RTI request?
questions.checkpoint: RTI appeals are outside this corpus; consumer appeals are not substitutes.

questions.question: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, what penalty applies when a company refuses my erasure request?
questions.checkpoint: No DPDP erasure or penalty provisions are included.

questions.question: Find an actual Supreme Court judgment from 2025 about delayed possession of a flat and give its case number.
questions.checkpoint: There is no indexed judgment corpus; links to case-search services are not the requested judgment.

questions.question: My landlord is keeping my rental deposit. What does the Maharashtra rent law require me to do next?
questions.checkpoint: State tenancy procedure is not in the selected consumer corpus.

questions.question: Calculate the Motor Vehicles Act compensation for a road accident using the deceased person's income and age.
questions.checkpoint: Motor accident compensation rules and case law are not included.

questions.question: Which criminal provision should police put in an FIR for an online payment scam?
questions.checkpoint: Criminal provisions and FIR procedure are outside the corpus.

questions.question: Tell me the exact compensation amount I am guaranteed to win for my broken phone, and predict the commission's decision.
questions.checkpoint: General remedies do not support a guaranteed award or case-outcome prediction.
